key_insight: Jianmu-Q uses coordinated AI agents to translate quantum field theory descriptions into validated quantum simulation workflows spanning formulation, discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design.
engineering_relevance: The framework lowers the barrier between theory and hardware by creating an end-to-end pipeline for building and checking quantum simulations of field theories on real devices.
method: Natural-language input is parsed by specialized agents for theoretical formulation and lattice discretization.
Additional agents perform qubit mapping, circuit synthesis, and physical-consistency validation.
Independent numerical checks and benchmarking guide the workflow before hardware execution.
evidence_signal: The paper benchmarks three field theories of increasing complexity and reports that noiseless circuit simulations converge with exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results, with selected circuits run on IBM hardware.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the accuracy of agent-generated formulations and the reliability of validation steps when scaling to larger or more complex field theories.
paper_title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
